cohort: Patients undergoing emergency surgical operations in 2nd and 3rd-level state hospitals in Turkey in 2019 and 2021.
finding: There was a 7.6% decrease in the number of emergency surgical operations performed in 2nd and 3rd-level state hospitals in Turkey in 2021 compared to 2019.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were one of the most frequently performed emergency surgical operations in both 2019 and 2021.
